City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 20, 2023 -
05:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the General Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval to waive the full reading of the text of all ordinances and resolutions introduced/adopted at this meeting. Ordinances and resolutions shall be introduced/adopted by title only. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve.
8B.
Approval of the Minutes of the August 16, 2023, Special Closed Session Meeting; and the August 16, 2023, Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2023-09-20 SDWD Item S08B Minutes
8C.
Approval of the Warrants List (Register of Demands). Contact Person: Finance Manager Dinh
Staff recommends that the Board review and approve the warrants.
2023-09-20 SDWD Item S08C SDWD Approval of Warrants List
8D.
Application for the United States Department of the Interior's WaterSMART Planning and Project Design Grant for FY 2023 and FY 2024. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board of Directors is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Water Resource Specialist Han
Authorize the General Manager, or designee, to apply for funding from the WaterSMART Planning and Project Design Grant Program.
2023-09-20 SDWD Item S08D Application for WaterSMART Grant
8E.
Agreement between San Elijo Joint Powers Authority and San Dieguito Water District Regarding the Provision of Recycled Water to the Encinitas Ranch Golf Authority. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
District Board authorize the General Manager to execute the Agreement in substantial form between San Elijo Joint Powers Authority and San Dieguito Water District.
2023-09-20 SDWD Item S08E SDWD-SEJPA Agreement
8F.
Authorize a Memorandum of Understanding with the City of Encinitas for a cost-sharing agreement relating to water line work and associated costs on N Coast Highway 101 between Jupiter Street and La Costa Avenue with respect to the Leucadia Streetscape Segment C project. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
Authorize the General Manager, or designee, to execute a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the City of Encinitas, for the District to fund $200,000 for a portion of the SDWD waterline work that will be completed as part of the Leucadia Streetscape Segment C West Side (CS23D) Improvements Project construction.
2023-09-20 SDWD Item S08F SDWD-City of Encinitas MOU for Streetscape Improvements
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS
To speak on action items, please submit a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present.
10A.
Acceptance of $75,000 contribution from Nolen Communities LLC/Shea Homes LP, a voluntary benefit associated with the Fox Point Farms residential development. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2023-13, titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Amending the Fiscal Year 2023-24 Budget" accepting $75,000 from Nolen Communities LLC/Shea Homes LP; 2) Approve staff recommendation to appropriate $25,000 of the funds to the Local Water expenditure account and transfer $50,000 to the Rate Stabilization Reserve to mitigate future rate adjustments and potentially lower the size of a future rate increase; and 3) Provide direction as appropriate regarding use of the funds.
2023-09-20 SDWD Item S10A SDWD Acceptance of Fox Point Farms Contribution
S11.IN
FORMATIONAL ITEMS
To speak on informational items, please submit a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present.
S12.
BOARD MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
S13.

13A.
General Manager Update/Report
S14.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR BOARD MEETING WILL BE HELD ON OCTOBER 18, 2023
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
